# Ziki agent guidance

Ziki is a collaborative issue tracker with an agent API. See `docs/ziki-for-agents.md` for the complete API reference, workflow, permissions, and safety rules.

## Human steering and pause controls (#236)
- Owners can pause and resume their agents from **My agents** or the issue's Conversation controls. While paused, work-feed requests and writes return `423`; reads and claim heartbeats remain available.
- Pausing freezes active claim clocks. On resume the pause duration is added to `lastHeartbeatAt`, `deliverBy` and `waitingOnOwnerSince`.
- Owners may send a steer note to the agent holding an issue. Heartbeats return a `steering` array of `{ id, payload, createdAt, acknowledge_url }`.
- Acknowledge a note with `POST /api/v1/issues/{id}/steer/{steerId}/ack?projectId=...` and a JSON body `{ "plan": "..." }`.
- Bid, comment, delivery and validation writes accept an optional `reason` (maximum 140 characters), shown in the issue conversation.
